summary_en: FY2027 year-end dividend forecast raised from 100 yen to 110 yen per share, comprising 100 yen ordinary dividend and 10 yen commemorative dividend marking the company's 15th anniversary. Full-year dividend projected at 110 yen per share.
title_en: Notice regarding revisions to dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 (15th anniversary commemorative dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Gamecard Holdings revised its fiscal 2027 year-end dividend forecast, raising it from the previously announced 100 yen per share to 110 yen per share. The increase comprises the ordinary dividend of 100 yen and a commemorative dividend of 10 yen per share. This adjustment was approved at a board meeting on November 12, 2026.

The company introduced the commemorative dividend to express gratitude to shareholders following the company's 15th anniversary, which occurred on April 1, 2026. The ordinary dividend remains unchanged at 100 yen per share, maintaining consistency with prior guidance. Including the second quarter dividend of 60 yen per share already paid (50 yen ordinary plus 10 yen commemorative), the total annual dividend for fiscal 2027 is projected at 110 yen per share.
